name: Together AI GPU Clusters - HGX H100 preemptible
price_basis: per H100 SXM GPU-hour, preemptible (pay-as-you-go), GPU Clusters product. Fetched 2026-10-04. Preemptible means the workload can be interrupted with limited notice. This is the per-GPU rate, NOT per-node.
notes: THE CHEAPEST PUBLISHED MANAGED-PROVIDER H100 RATE FOUND IN THIS RESEARCH. Together AI GPU Clusters preemptible H100 at $1.99/GPU-hr is 64% below their own on-demand rate ($3.99), 69% below CoreWeave on-demand ($6.16), and 71% below AWS p5 on-demand ($6.88). It is even below the CoreWeave spot rate ($2.46/GPU-hr). This is the floor price for managed H100 inference. The tradeoff is preemption risk - workloads must be designed to handle interruption. For batch inference or fault-tolerant workloads, this is the price point to beat.
